documents.title: Services & pricing
documents.text: Homecare inspections cost £95 for 60 minutes. Maintenance visits cost £125 for 90 minutes. A 30-minute project consultation is free. These are fictional demonstration prices.

documents.title: Bookings & changes
documents.text: Sample appointments use London time. A visit can be changed or cancelled after you confirm the details. This demonstration updates a local sample register only. No real appointment is made.

documents.title: Invoices & payment queries
documents.text: The assistant can retrieve sample invoice balances and prepare an invoice-query ticket for review. It cannot collect payments, change invoice amounts, or mark an invoice paid.

documents.title: Support & human handoff
documents.text: Service enquiries can be captured as a sample ticket with a summary for a colleague. The fictional team operates Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00 London time. This is not an emergency service.

documents.title: Finnovative FP&A services
documents.text: Finnovative scopes custom FP&A reporting, budget-versus-actual reviews, margin analysis, forecasts and financial dashboards around a company’s data and approved rules. The public tools use synthetic records. Private deployment, access controls and provider data handling are agreed per client. Book a consultation to discuss your workflow; this demo does not access company financial data.
